anomalies.observed: The MAX3485 data-input pin U2.4 is connected to NET0004. On the two M-Bus connectors, NET0004 is the net on pin 13, while pin 15 is NET0043 and is not connected to U2.
anomalies.expected: The specification states that the MAX3485 is fed from the M5Stack PortC UART /TXD2//RXD2 on J1/J2 pins 15/16, so the transceiver DI input should be on the TXD2 net associated with pin 15, not on the pin-13 net.

evidence.quote: U2 pin 4 DI is labeled NET0004; J10/J5 left-column labels show pin 13 = NET0004 and pin 15 = NET0043 (single schematic sheet).
fed from the M5Stack's PortC UART (`/TXD2`/`/RXD2`, J1/J2 pins 15/16)

anomalies.impact: In serial-servo mode the MAX3485 would be driven from the wrong bus GPIO/UART line (pin 13 instead of the specified TXD2 pin 15), so the intended PortC serial servo bus would not behave as specified.

parsed.summary: The schematic largely matches the described topology, but the MAX3485 DI connection appears to be tied to the bus net on pin 13 instead of the specified PortC TXD2 net on pin 15.
